summary: Changes tax_for to return None for unknown regions instead of zero tax. Both callers in the shop package do arithmetic on the result.

findings.title: None return crashes both callers for unknown regions
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for any region not in RATES. order_total in checkout.py adds that None to an int, and tax_line in receipt.py divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout and receipt printing raise TypeError for every customer outside the three listed regions. Before this change those customers paid zero tax and completed checkout.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions, or update order_total and tax_line to handle None before doing arithmetic.

findings.title: New unknown-region branch has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a branch that returns None for unknown regions. The repository contains no test files, so nothing exercises this branch or its callers.
findings.consequence: The caller breakage in checkout.py and receipt.py goes unnoticed until a customer in an unlisted region hits it in production.
findings.fix: Add a test for tax_for with an unknown region, and tests for order_total and tax_line with the same input.
